assertions.source: No constant-coeff recurrence of order ≤4 fits c_2..c_10 by over-determination (extends eca145ca). Expected False.

assertions.name: tail_dominant_mode_is_the_pole
assertions.source: The tail (k≥6) order-1 dominant characteristic root equals 1/u_substrate within 5% ⇒ the pole at u_substrate is the leading recurrence mode.

description: First cut at the q-difference kernel R: tests whether the canonical c_2..c_10 are C-finite (⟺ F rational). Hankel scan shows no low-order collapse; no constant-coeff recurrence of order ≤4 fits the full sequence by over-determination (extends eca145ca). The tail (k≥6) order-1 dominant root matches 1/u_substrate to 6.47544e-6 — confirming the pole as the leading mode — but the subleading kernel structure needs more rungs (only k=8,9,10 are asymptotic). Pinning R requires canonical c_11+ or a categorical derivation of Q_A·cos α_eff. CAVEAT: the ~1e-5 residual floor sits at the c_k empirical-extraction accuracy (c_3 near-match, c_4 CODATA-fit), so the subleading kernel is not separable from extraction noise with the current c_k. Formalize-first; no fitting to experiment; diagnostic-only.

data.residual_floor_note: ~1e-5 residual floor = c_k empirical-extraction accuracy (c_3 near-match, c_4 CODATA-fit); subleading kernel not separable from extraction noise with current c_k.
